## Honors & Awards

- **NREL High-Impact Business Development Award** *(2025)* — Internal recognition for securing \$800,000 in industry-funded research projects.
- **NREL Key Contributor Award** *(2023, 2025)* — Internal award recognizing exceptional research contributions and project impact.
- **Best Poster at [ISSST](https://issst.net/) Academic Conference** *(2022)* — Awarded best poster for research on optimization-based carbon capture and thermal energy storage systems.
- **Reviewer for the ASME [IDETC-CIE](https://event.asme.org/IDETC-CIE), [ISSST](https://issst.net/), and [IEEE-EESAT](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/xpl/conhome/10890885/proceeding) Academic Conferences** *(2022 -- 2025)* — Reviewed conference submissions for research quality and methodological soundness.
- **Physics & Astronomy Graduating Student of the Year** *(2020)* — Recognition of academic success from Regis University.
- **CoSIDA Academic All-District First Team** *(2020)* — NCAA recognition for academic and basketball success.
- **Full College Athletic Scholarship Awarded for 4 Years** *(2016 -- 2020)* — Managed consistent academic success while competing in the NCAA basketball league.
